setup_intro:
Setting up dzmod.

Steam login
  Username of a Steam account that owns DayZ.
  dzmod does not store a password. On the first download SteamCMD
  signs in by itself and remembers the login.

SteamID64 and Steam Web API key (optional)
  Only needed to list your subscribed DayZ mods.
  SteamID64: 17 digits, shown under https://store.steampowered.com/account
  Create a key: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey

Saved to: {path}
